16 Popular Franchise Movies in 2026 (Sequels, Reboots & Spin-offs)

Avengers: Doomsday, Jumanji 3, Hunger Games are some of the biggest 2026 movies tied to popular franchises, books, video games, comics, and existing series. From Marvel to DC, Disney to Pixar, across Hollywood studios.

In chronological order, here are some of the biggest movies for the rest of 2026 relating to popular franchises, books, comics, video games, and existing series. Marvel and DC, Disney and Pixar. Some fun sequels, reboots, and spin-offs.

We’ll be linking the Incluvie reviews as the movies release. I’m super excited for some of these, especially the ones towards the second half of the year!

1. The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — April 1, 2026

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie Delivers Exactly What is Promised – by Bheema Bachus

2. Mortal Kombat II — May 8, 2026

5. Supergirl — June 26, 2026

6. Minions & Monsters — July 1, 2026

7. Moana (live action) — July 10, 2026

9. Avatar: Aang, The Last Airbender — July 24, 2026

10. Street Fighter — October 16, 2026

11. Godzilla Minus Zero — November 6, 2026

12. Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping  — Nov 20, 2026

13. Focker In-Law — Nov 27, 2026

15. Avengers: Doomsday — Dec 18, 2026

16. Dune: Part Three — Dec 18, 2026
